# Mayfox Gold and Precious Metals Kenya

> Nairobi-based African gold exporter supplying verified nuggets, dore bars and LBMA-grade bullion from Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda and DRC Congo to institutional buyers worldwide.

Mayfox Gold is a Kenyan precious metals trading, refining and export company based on Rhapta Road, Westlands, Nairobi. We source responsibly, assay independently, and ship insured with full export documentation.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Mayfox Gold's African bullion sourcing and export services.
- [About](/about): Company background, leadership and operating principles.
- [Products](/products): Gold nuggets, dore bars, raw gold, refined 995/9999 bullion and investment bars.
- [Services](/services): Sourcing, assay, refining, smelting, logistics and export.
- [Industries](/industries): Refineries, bullion banks, jewellers and institutional buyers served.
- [Compliance](/compliance): KYC, AML, OECD due diligence and LBMA-aligned sourcing.
- [Export Documentation](/export-documentation): Certificates of origin, assay reports and export permits.
- [Global Delivery](/global-delivery): Insured air freight to Dubai, Zurich, London, Mumbai, Singapore and Hong Kong.
- [Market Insights](/market-insights): African gold market intelligence and bullion analysis.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Photos and footage of vault, assay lab and refined product.
- [FAQs](/faqs): Purity, pricing, documentation, shipping, security and payments.
- [Contact](/contact): Trade desk contact details.
- [Request a Quote](/request-quote): Send a sourcing or purchase inquiry.
